common_issues.detail: Claimed 'Nidus or Nidus Prime must be owned and left on Orbiter'. Actual mechanic: any Warframe with a 7-day matured Helminth Cyst is taken to Helminth Infirmary where the cyst is drained to produce imprints. Fixed acquisition source and both body paragraphs.
Stated doubled resource buff lasts 30 seconds. Actual duration is approximately 2 minutes (120 seconds). Corrected in abilities section.

common_issues.issue: Tenet weapon element mismatch (Corrosive label vs radiation field)
common_issues.detail: Page named 'Corrosive' but element field was 'radiation'. Corrosive = Toxin + Electric in Warframe. Sister source element corrected to 'toxin'. Page renamed to Tenet Tetra (Toxin). Requiem pattern changed from specific mods to 'randomized-at-spawn' placeholder.

common_issues.issue: Tenet weapon element mismatch (Blast label vs impact field)
common_issues.detail: Page named 'Blast' but element field was 'impact'. Impact is physical, not a Blast source. Blast = Heat + Cold. Sister source element corrected to 'heat'. Page renamed to Tenet Detron (Heat). Body text updated to explain heat-to-blast conversion via mods. Requiem pattern changed from specific mods to 'randomized-at-spawn' placeholder.

All four lich files had specific Requiem mod sequences in frontmatter (e.g. Ris/Lohk/Fass). The schema requires a 3-tuple but patterns are randomized per Lich at spawn. Changed all to 'randomized-at-spawn' placeholders. Body text in all files correctly stated patterns are random.

common_issues.issue: Amp files had Fandom-only sources (no primary source)
common_issues.detail: All four amp files had two Fandom wiki URLs as sources with no primary reference. CLAUDE.md requires at least one primary source (WFCD, warframestat.us, warframe.market). Amp data is not in WFCD JSON, so warframestat.us added as primary source with explanatory note.

common_issues.issue: Focus school files had Fandom-only primary sources
common_issues.detail: All five focus school files used Fandom wiki + warframe.com/news as sources. Focus school data is absent from WFCD JSON. warframestat.us added as primary source with note explaining the data gap.
